methodology.title: منهجية استخراج مواضيع الكتابة (Writing Topics)
methodology.description: يتم استخراج مواضيع الكتابة من نهاية كل درس في كتاب الطالب وكتاب النشاط.

topics.title: Write a paragraph about the most interesting pages you like to follow on social media.
guiding_questions: Why do you like to follow them?
topics.sample_essay: I like to follow educational pages on social media because they help me learn new things every day. I also follow sports pages because I love football and watch matches. These pages share useful videos, pictures, and interesting stories. They make me happy and I enjoy spending my free time watching them with my friends.
